summary.headline: Table of Annual Entrances
summary.text: Table of the 36th year of worldly revolution entrances from Rabiʿ al-Awwal through Shaʿban, correlating equatorial and seasonal positions with Hijri, Roman, Jalali, Alexandrian, Cathay, and other chronological systems. The Rajab entry lists Taurus, Libra, Scorpio, Cancer, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, Saturn, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, the Sun, the Galaxy, and related stars and lots.
